title: Dashboard
description: An overview page: title, KPI row with trends, a revenue chart, orders by status and the latest orders. Copy it with `semi add dashboard`, then replace the sample data.
when: The home page of an admin or operations app: a few numbers, one trend, what needs attention.

instead.need: A page that is mostly one list

a11y: One h1 (PageTitle); every chart has a table view; KPI trends say “so với tuần trước” in text, not colour only.
